name: Shugenja
ability: You start knowing if your closest evil player is clockwise or anti-clockwise. If equidistant, this info is arbitrary.
wakes: First night only, or the night they become the Shugenja mid-game.
interaction: Learns: The direction (clockwise or anti-clockwise) of the closest evil player, by fewest seats. If evil players are equally close both ways, the Storyteller picks either direction.
drunk_or_poisoned: If drunk or poisoned the Storyteller may point either way. The engine offers the wrong direction as the misinformation option.

rulings.text: Closest means the fewest steps around the circle from the Shugenja. The distance itself is never given.
If evil players are equally close in both directions the Storyteller chooses, and the Shugenja is not told the answer was arbitrary.
A Shugenja created mid-game wakes that night to learn the information.

test_scenarios.name: closest evil is clockwise
test_scenarios.setup: Seats clockwise: Alice Shugenja, Bob Chef, Cara Imp, Dan Monk, Eve Saint, Finn Baron, Gus Empath, Hal Mayor. Cara is 2 seats clockwise, Finn is 3 seats anti-clockwise.

test_scenarios.name: equidistant is arbitrary
test_scenarios.setup: Seats clockwise: Alice Shugenja, Bob Imp, Cara Chef, Dan Monk, Eve Poisoner. Bob and Eve are each 1 seat away.
test_scenarios.expected: The Storyteller decision offers both clockwise and anti-clockwise as truthful; whichever is picked, Alice learns it.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned Shugenja
test_scenarios.setup: Seats clockwise: Alice Shugenja, Gus Saint, Bob Imp, Cara Chef, Dan Monk, Finn Poisoner. Bob is 2 seats clockwise, Finn is 1 seat anti-clockwise.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: Finn poisons Alice before she wakes.
test_scenarios.expected: Truthful anti-clockwise and misinformation clockwise are offered; the Storyteller picks clockwise and Alice learns clockwise.

test_scenarios.name: Recluse may register as evil
test_scenarios.setup: Seats clockwise: Alice Shugenja, Bob Recluse, Cara Chef, Dan Monk, Eve Imp, Finn Empath. Bob is 1 seat clockwise, Eve is 2 seats anti-clockwise.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 1: the Storyteller has Bob register as evil.
test_scenarios.expected: Bob is the closest evil player, so Alice learns clockwise.
